name: ce1 bare node specifiers match node: forms
source: import fs from "fs"; import util from "util"; import os from "os"; import assert from "assert"; import crypto from "crypto"; import { Readable } from "stream"; import { existsSync } from "fs"; import * as nodeUtil from "util"; function main(): void { console.log(fs.existsSync("/etc"), existsSync("/definitely/not/here")); console.log(util.inspect({ a: 1 }), nodeUtil.format("%s-%d", "x", 4)); assert.strictEqual(1, 1); console.log(typeof os.platform(), crypto.createHash("md5").update("a").digest("hex")); Readable.from(["a", "b"]).on("data", (d: string) => console.log(d)); }
